system.description:
As part of the same action used to use your Shadow Possession clan feature or any Jutsu that inflicts the Shadow Bound condition, you attempt to strangle all affected creatures. If a creature fails their saving throw against your Shadow Possession, they take 3d12 Bludgeoning or Necrotic damage as they have their throats crushed by their own Shadows, on a failed save, they take half damage and no further effects.

Bright. The Shadowy hands pulls a creature who failed their saving throw to the ground, prone.

Dimly Lit. A creature that succeeded their saving throw gains a rank of Demoralized or Shaken, your choice.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d12.
